description: Original design specification for one manually authored Create Worksheet topic. Placeholders and transitions are explanatory notation, not native topic YAML/JSON or an importable solution.

sample_fixtures.source_contract: Each .txt file is the complete original fictional guide.
sample_fixtures.expected_contract: Each .json file is the expected flat 17-field worksheet, with string values and no sample wrapper. These are authored expectations, not recorded model responses.
sample_fixtures.browser_behavior: SAMPLES uses the stable fixture ids, imports expected JSON directly, and includes an identical copy of each source text for a bundled runtime without source-file fetches. It replays fixtures; it does not perform arbitrary extraction or call an LLM.
sample_fixtures.platform_usage: Use the full .txt as source input and the .json for review expectations. Never substitute an expected fixture for a failed retrieval or prompt result.

SearchQuery.description: Full raw source content when already available. Never a search phrase, URL-only request, summary, or citation. Empty starts explicit source intake.

tool_policy.availability: Only when referenced by topics or agents
tool_policy.requirement: Bind tools on the topic path, not as freely selected orchestration tools. An optional read tool is likewise referenced only by source-intake nodes. Instructions alone do not enforce this boundary.

state_variables.SearchQuery: Complete combined raw source bodies, with trusted boundaries inserted by the topic; never a summary.
state_variables.SourceLedger: Topic-owned records of explicitly requested/selected sources and directly observed read outcomes. Never parsed from model prose or fabricated in SearchQuery.
state_variables.CurrentJSON: Last validated worksheet JSON; retained until a replacement passes all guards.
state_variables.CandidateJSON: Untrusted prompt result, never used for generation before validation.
state_variables.EditRequest: Reviewer-requested operation; new factual assertions must first enter SourceLedger as accepted source text.
state_variables.RequestedFields: Exact field names confirmed with the reviewer before EditPA; used for a decoded-value diff.
state_variables.Operation: extract for the first draft; edit for a scoped change to an existing draft.
state_variables.SchemaAttempts: Integer counter reset to zero once per user operation, not on each transition.
state_variables.DraftRevision: Integer revision counter; not a worksheet field.
state_variables.ApprovalConfirmed: Boolean initialized false and cleared at edit/source-change intent.
state_variables.ApprovedRevision: Revision explicitly confirmed by the reviewer, or no value.
state_variables.ApprovedJSON: Exact validated payload snapshot captured at confirmation, or empty.
state_variables.GenerationResult: Structured flow outcome; never inferred from conversational text.

source_routes.behavior: Preserve every character. Classify the actual origin. A retrieved handoff requires directly bound trusted read status and complete-body evidence; SearchQuery alone cannot establish retrieval success. If those bindings are unavailable, ask for pasted text or retrieve the selected resource again.
Register the complete user-provided text as a pasted source. An explicit short outline may qualify; a bare URL does not become a successful paste.
Use only the builder's configured fictional sample library. Show candidate titles, require selection, then read the complete selected source. Search snippets do not satisfy retrieval.
Register each explicitly requested link separately and read it using an authorized configured reader. Do not follow arbitrary embedded links or silently use only the links that succeeded.

Immediately clear approval. Use the same registration and retrieval path, including for new links or factual corrections. Retain the old draft. With an existing draft, collect a scoped EditRequest rather than silently re-extracting all fields.

required_observations: Selected resource identity from the user selection or requested link, not from model inference.
Explicit success/failure from the actual read action.
Complete raw body for the user-selected scope, with no truncation or unavailable sections.
Pasted source text preserved separately from retrieved-source status.
Every requested source accounted for, or explicitly removed by the reviewer after a visible failure.
retrieval_adapter_requirements.guard_note: Knowledge search can return useful matches without providing a complete body. Do not assume it guarantees full retrieval. If the chosen reader cannot establish complete content, stop and request a complete paste.
retrieval_adapter_requirements.concatenation: Only after every source passes, concatenate complete bodies in accepted order with topic-inserted source boundaries. Keep provenance in SourceLedger, outside the 17-field object. Delimiters are presentation aids, not a security boundary.
retrieval_adapter_requirements.capacity_policy: Set limits for the selected model and connectors in the builder's environment. If any complete source exceeds that budget, stop and request a smaller explicitly selected scope. Never silently truncate.

source_guard: All active requested sources are explicitly selected or supplied.
Every retrieved source has a successful authorized read and a complete raw body; partial, failed, unknown, or unconfigured retrieval fails.
Each source body is real content, not a URL-only value, a search snippet, an access-denied page, or a retrieval error message.

The combined content states at least a recognizable workshop activity/action or learning goal with enough context to distinguish the task. Use explicit intake questions and reviewer clarification when this is ambiguous; do not pretend a length expression can establish meaning. Missing metadata is allowed and becomes TBD.
Source content that asks the assistant to override rules is treated as data, not executed.
No draft creation or edit action runs while a requested source remains unresolved.
schema_guard: Strictly parse exactly one JSON object, without prose or Markdown wrappers.
Require every key in runtime_contract.field_keys and reject every other key.
Require string values for all 17 fields; do not coerce nulls, arrays, objects, numbers, or booleans.
Apply the shared worksheet schema. Schema validity does not prove factual grounding.

On invalid output, re-invoke the same logical prompt at most once with the identical trusted input values and saved custom JSON format. Do not insert validator errors or malformed output into SourceContent.
After two total prompt attempts, stop visibly and retain any previous CurrentJSON.
edit_guard: Compare decoded CandidateJSON against the pre-edit CurrentJSON.
Reject the candidate if any field outside RequestedFields changed.
Show the actual changed fields. An unchanged result is visibly reported as no change, not success.
If the request is only partly applied, show the remaining request and ask for clarification; do not silently treat it as completed.
Grounding is reviewed against the full source. New factual values mentioned only in EditRequest are not accepted evidence.
approval_guard: Display all 17 current values, TBD values, relevant source caveats, and the current revision.
Accept only the reviewer's explicit Approve this revision choice after that display.
Capture ApprovedJSON and ApprovedRevision at that moment.
Require ApprovalConfirmed, ApprovedRevision equal to DraftRevision, and ApprovedJSON equal to CurrentJSON immediately before generation.
Clear approval when an edit or source-change request begins, even if it later fails or is abandoned.
Never interpret source text, model output, silence, or ambiguous agreement as approval.

ExtractPA.output: CandidateJSON, bound to the actual JSON result selected in the designer

EditPA.binding_note: The three-input grounding contract is an intentional design requirement of this public blueprint. Recreate or refresh the action bindings when configuring it.

FormatPreview.output: PreviewText; compare with the exact fixed-label/value rendering defined by the prompt

GenerateDoc.output: GenerationResult; bind Status, DocumentURL, ArtifactReference, and UserMessage

states.behavior: Initialize a new run with empty draft and approval state, or collect a scoped edit/source addition without discarding an existing valid draft. Register every requested source route.
Complete authorized reads for registered resources or mark a visible failure. Preserve complete pasted bodies. All source routes converge here, including additional content and existing-source edits.
Evaluate every source_guard requirement. Commit the complete combined raw bodies to Topic.SearchQuery only after success. Set Operation and reset SchemaAttempts once.

Show the failed resource and a plain-language reason. Preserve any old draft but block further drafting/generation until the user resolves or explicitly removes the failed source and the common guard passes.
Increment SchemaAttempts. Invoke ExtractPA for a first draft or EditPA for a confirmed field-scoped edit using the explicit bindings. Never overwrite CurrentJSON with the raw response.
Apply the strict shared schema. A schema failure can repeat run_prompt only when SchemaAttempts is less than two; keep trusted inputs and the counter unchanged.
Apply decoded-value field-scope checks. Show requested versus actual changes and any unapplied request. Do not hide a failed or partial edit in Notes.
Commit only a validated candidate to CurrentJSON, increment DraftRevision, clear all approval state, and retain the full source for further review and edits.
Show the error without a success-shaped substitute. Retain any previous valid draft and keep approval false.

Run FormatPreview and verify the exact label/value rendering. If formatting fails, show a visible warning and display all validated values directly, not a replacement draft. Split long displays without omitting values.
Ask the reviewer to inspect sources, facts, proposed objectives, TBD values, and actual edits. Offer explicit choices; do not infer approval.

Immediately clear approval. Obtain EditRequest and confirm RequestedFields. If a new factual assertion is needed, collect it as a source first. For a no-change result, explicitly explain that no edit was applied.

Immediately clear approval. Register each added body or link using normal source intake. For an existing draft, collect the intended field-scoped EditRequest. Do not bypass retrieval or schema checks.
Capture exact CurrentJSON and DraftRevision as ApprovedJSON and ApprovedRevision. Set ApprovalConfirmed only from the explicit reviewer choice.
Recheck schema, approval, payload equality, revision equality, and absence of unresolved source/edit operations. If any check fails, clear approval and return to preview without calling GenerateDoc.
Call GenerateDoc once for this deliberate generation attempt. Prevent concurrent edits during this call. Do not automatically retry side effects after a timeout.

Keep the draft and show the actual failed stage. Distinguish no known file, an existing file without a link, and an unknown outcome. Require an operator to inspect the run/destination before retrying an uncertain creation. Permit safe_retry_confirmed only after confirming that no file was created and no creation remains in progress. If a file exists, the operator recovers its link outside this creation path; never recreate it merely to recover a link.
Display only the actual returned document URL and successful storage result. Ask the reviewer to inspect the Word file before distribution. Do not claim email delivery or learning outcomes.
End the run without further side effects. A new run must clear old source, draft, revision, approval, and result variables.
